articles.title: Toyota Motor Corporation Chairman Akio Toyoda Inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame
articles.description: TORONTO, September 24, 2026 – In recognition of his global automotive leadership that has brought passion, performance and purpose into modern mobility, Akio Toyoda, chairman of the board, Toyota Motor Corporation (TMC), was inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame last night in Detroit.

articles.title: Toyota Canada releases August sales results
articles.description: TORONTO, September 1, 2026 – Electrified vehicles led August sales for Toyota Canada Inc. (TCI), reaching a record of 14,461 electrified units sold last month, up 35.6% year over year (YOY).

articles.title: Toyota contributes $100,000 to wildfire relief efforts in Canada
articles.description: Toyota Canada, Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada, and Toyota Financial Services donate $100,000 to Canadian Red Cross Canadian Wildfire Fund

articles.title: Toyota Canada releases July sales results
articles.description: TORONTO, August 4, 2026 – Toyota Canada Inc. (TCI) recorded its best ever July for electrified vehicle sales at 16,481 electrified units sold, up 47.5% year-over-year (YOY) and representing 65.8% of the company’s overall sales last month.

articles.title: Toyota Mobility Foundation and MaRS Announce Call for Applicants for Mobility Unlimited Hub’s Third Cohort
articles.description: Startups tackling active mobility and cognitive health challenges are invited to apply to this targeted program.
